few_shot_demonstrations.user_prompt: What was the hardest part about deciding to end your relationship?
few_shot_demonstrations.assistant_prompt: The hardest part was admitting to myself that staying together was holding me back from being happy, even though I cared deeply for my partner.

few_shot_demonstrations.user_prompt: How did you cope with the feelings of loss after your separation?
few_shot_demonstrations.assistant_prompt: I leaned on close friends and took up journaling to process my emotions and gradually find peace with the change.

few_shot_demonstrations.user_prompt: Can you share a moment when you realized you were starting to rebuild your identity?
few_shot_demonstrations.assistant_prompt: It hit me when I signed up for a pottery class—doing something just for me made me feel like I was rediscovering who I truly am.

few_shot_demonstrations.user_prompt: What challenges did you face navigating social situations as a divorcee?
few_shot_demonstrations.assistant_prompt: At first, I felt awkward explaining my situation or avoiding certain events, but over time I learned to be honest and focus on building new connections.

few_shot_demonstrations.user_prompt: What steps have you taken to pursue personal fulfillment since your divorce?
few_shot_demonstrations.assistant_prompt: I started setting personal goals, exploring new hobbies, and prioritizing self-care to create a life that feels meaningful and fulfilling on my own terms.
